notes.title: Important Update Regarding Early Access
notes.notes: [p]Greetings everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been looking forward to revealing more about the road ahead for Olden Era and providing an update that many of you have been eagerly awaiting. [/p][p][/p][p]First, thank you for the incredible support and feedback you've shared with us since Olden Era was first revealed. You are the heart that keeps this series blooming in a myriad of ways, and we are truly grateful to bring joy to all of you through this project! [/p][p][/p][p]Now, to the heart of the matter, the release of Olden Era. [/p][p][/p][p]While we had hoped to bring the Early Access version to you sooner, we’ve made the tough but necessary decision to postpone its release to later in 2025. This wasn’t a decision we made lightly, but one made to ensure we give Olden Era the care it deserves. From the beginning, our goal has been to create something truly special, and that takes time, care, and iteration. However, as an indie studio, we need a bit more time to get everything ready for the big Early Access release.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve received an overwhelming amount of feedback. Thank you to everyone who’s been sharing their thoughts and ideas. It truly means a lot to us. Now we need a bit of time to carefully go through everything, organize it, and, most importantly, turn your suggestions into actual gameplay improvements. Without your watchful eyes and constructive insight, we wouldn't have gone as far as we currently have. [/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, we have expanded the playtests to include even more people and continue to receive feedback from hundreds of our internal beta testers as well! We're also looking through all the community feedback on our social media as well as community websites and groups about everything we've revealed so far to make changes based on what you've shared with us. Many of the improvements we’ve posted in past updates are just the beginning; we've updated Temple Town and the Angels based on what you've shared with us, added more readability and accessibility options, and even more enhancements and surprises are on the way, with one of them unveiled now: the updated Necropolis town screen. [/p][previewyoutube="PuJcFPZ-6EI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We want you alongside us every step of the way and hope for your understanding in wanting to deliver Olden Era in the best shape we can. Thank you for walking this path with us. May we meet on the fields of Jadame in 2025. [/p]

notes.title: Community | First update of Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era!
notes.notes:
2024 was an awesome year for the HoMM community and us — we've unveiled [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FvBaMRpj4fg&ab_channel=UnfrozenOfficial]Olden Era at Gamescom[/url], got to know all of you brilliant people, and showed you so many amazing reveals like [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sC-RNG3B60U&ab_channel=UnfrozenOfficial]Necropolis[/url]  and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LQznkeUQYcI&ab_channel=UnfrozenOfficial]Dungeon[/url]  factions, including the latest music one — with [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_7UiZws6vL0&ab_channel=UnfrozenOfficial]Paul Romero, Cris Velasco, and Heroes Orchestra[/url]! 
We at Unfrozen have the vision and team to do the heavy lifting, but it's your feedback that shapes and polishes Olden Era's journey to Early Access.
We wanted to wrap up this year with the first [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GOPWbg6_jfo&ab_channel=UnfrozenOfficial]Community Feedback Update video[/url]. Let's see how we've applied your thoughts and comments alongside a few extra goodies you haven't had a chance to take a good look at before! We're planning to have more of such videos in 2025 ✨ 

We can't wait for the release day in Q2 2025 to arrive and we hope you'll continue this journey alongside us! 

🎆 Happy New Year, everyone!🎆
